svg.title: G-04 - Hull lines plan
svg.text: HULL LINES - PLAN VIEW OF THE OUTER SKIN
Bow to the right, starboard at the bottom. Stations every 6 m from the forward perpendicular (FP, station 0, z = -63.0 m).
skin at other 2 m levels, keel and roof
SKIN HALF-BREADTHS (m) AT THE STATIONS - at each deck floor level; HB = half-breadth
Hull sides lean outward with height (about 9 deg);
nacelles stand outside the skin on each beam.
HALF-BREADTH PLAN: SKIN CONTOURS EVERY 2 m, DECK FLOORS COLOURED
